subject: BlueNorth trial ops commitment and kickoff timing
summary: Post-discovery follow-up that captures agreed success criteria, an updated 3-week POC timeline after customer asks to shift by one week, owner assignments (Mike = customer owner, Neha = Redwood onboarding), onboarding access requests, and a weekly nudge to lock kickoff date and pilot commercial terms.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-03T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + proposed POC structure and next steps

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight POC runbook so we can lock timelines and owners.

High-level goal (what we heard): BlueNorth wants to validate that Redwood reduces average document-processing latency for your ingestion pipeline and improves extraction accuracy for the two target templates (Invoices, Purchase Orders) with a sample of ~10k records.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: 50% reduction in average inference time for 1kB payloads vs current baseline (measured at BlueNorth load profile)
- Accuracy: entity extraction F1 >= 0.88 on the annotated sample set
- Throughput: sustained 200 TPS during peak batch runs without errors or timeouts
- Reliability: zero data exfiltration; logs retained per your retention policy (we'll produce audit logs)

POC structure (suggested):
- Duration: 3 weeks (kickoff -> pilot validation -> handoff). Proposed kickoff: 2026-08-17
- Redwood owners: Marcus Lin (sales lead), Neha Kapoor (onboarding & CS)
- BlueNorth owners: Mike Harris (integration lead), Sara Patel (product sponsor)
- Deliverables: onboarding checklist, runbook, weekly status notes, final acceptance report

Immediate asks from BlueNorth to finalize kickoff:
1) Confirm that the success criteria above map to your expectations
2) Confirm Mike as the BlueNorth day-to-day owner and availability windows for a 60-min kickoff the week of Aug 17
3) Provide a 1-2 example documents (redacted) and the schema mapping for invoice/PO fields so Neha can do a pre-kickoff mapping
I've attached a draft POC runbook (BN-POC-Runbook-v1.xlsx) and a short checklist. If you prefer a slightly later start that's fine — call out required dates and we'll adjust.

Thanks — I'll follow up with Neha to scope the data access and Lauren for commercial alignment.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0118
Redwood Inference

Quick internal note and checklist for the pre-kickoff items — copying customer so they see the asks.

Onboarding pre-kicklist (Neha -> BlueNorth asks):
- Secure upload: we can accept SFTP or temporary S3 bucket with pre-signed URLs and limited IAM. Which is easiest for you?
- Sample data: 250-500 redacted documents preferred (mix of invoices & POs) + a CSV mapping of the fields you expect extracted
- Access: one service account IP range for testing or VPN access if you require private network
- Test schema: please include a small ground-truth CSV for 50 records for initial accuracy checks

I can provision a test environment and initial model configuration within 48 hours of receiving the sample data. I'll also prepare an onboarding_checklist.pdf and pre-kickoff validation script that runs basic throughput/latency checks.

Tech question for Marcus / Lauren: any constraint on hours for the kickoff? I prefer mornings PT.
